title: Museum rooms and zoo rooms
content: I don't have a full museum but just museum rooms tucked away inside stores and hotels. They will be a more quiet space and usually someone is quietly observing the room - not guards but more like caretakers or docents, making sure the displays are left undisturbed and offering information if asked, but never approaching me or volunteering help or info. They'll just watch or go about their own small tasks unless directly approached. They are always wearing older victorian clothes even if the museum room is modern. Also I don't have a full zoo, just zoo rooms inside of other spaces, and they do not have anyone working in them like the museum rooms do. They only have giraffes, birds, walking paths, and a lot of foliage. Basically aviary rooms with at least one giraffe in each one.
